data.content: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my to-do list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed","so_that":"I can see which work is finished","business_description":"Users can set a task's status to Completed. Open and In Progress are set through the edit form, so the status change accepts only Completed. The Completion Date is recorded when the task is completed.","business_value":"Users can track finished work and the Completed count stays accurate.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open or In Progress exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"a task with status Open or In Progress exists","when":"the user marks it as Completed and the backend returns success","then":"a success message is displayed and the row shows the status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed, including Open or In Progress","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"}],"edge_cases":["Open and In Progress cannot be set through the status change; they are set only through the edit form.","A request to mark a task as Completed while the backend has not yet responded must not show a Completed status or a success message.","The wording of the success and error messages is not specified."],"dependencies":[],"definition_of_done":["All acceptance criteria are met","Backend and frontend behaviour covered by automated tests","No optimistic update is shown in the task list"]},"fixes":[{"finding":1,"revised_tasks":[]}]}
